plan.archetype: Flexible early damage into poison and scalable defense
plan.bossPrep: Prepare upgraded AoE for followers, sustained damage for the priest, Weak and multi-hit mitigation. Enter healthy with useful potions.
plan.summary: Acquire efficient damage and AoE first, then poison scaling and stronger defense. Remove Strikes after adding replacements. Adapt to the card pack; fight elites only with adequate health and damage.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with efficient AoE and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with follower-clearing AoE, upgraded poison and reliable block. Save Wails for volleys; exploit Gremlin Horn kills for energy and draw.
plan.summary: Heal now and avoid elites. Add AoE, poison scaling, efficient block and draw. Remove unsupported Tactician before Strikes. Upgrade poison or Neutralize when health permits; three Wails already provide sufficient temporary mitigation.

plan.archetype: Retained poison burst with scalable block
plan.bossPrep: Establish poison and Accelerant early. Play Frantic Escape before sand expires; separately block attacks. Save Wails for multihits and obtain defensive potions.
plan.summary: Prioritize Accelerant, poison-compatible block, and draw over additional poison sources. Shop early, use three rests, and avoid optional elites. Remove Tactician then Strikes; upgrade Bullet Time and core poison when healing is unnecessary.
